kal1: How many seconds does it take you to stand up from a chair, walk 3 metres, come back and sit down? Do the Timed Up and Go (TUG) test with a stopwatch, compare with the average for your age and learn the signs of fall risk.
kal2: How many seconds does it take you to stand up from a chair, walk 3 metres, turn, come back and sit down again? The Timed Up and Go test (TUG) is a simple test used to assess mobility and fall risk. The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) considers older adults who take 12 seconds or more to complete it to be at risk of falling. Try it with someone beside you, using the stopwatch below.
